definition_zh: 在光滑預奇異 Navier–Stokes 演化上，應變能量定義為 \(E_0(t)= rac12\|S(t)\|_2^2\)（§2）。
definition_en: On smooth pre-singular Navier–Stokes evolution, the strain energy is defined by \(E_0(t)= rac12\|S(t)\|_2^2\) (§2).
notes: Miller strain identities (§1.1); all C5-C cumulative identities act on smooth pre-singular solutions.

definition_en:
Strain enstrophy (the \(\dot H^1\) energy) is defined by \(E_1(t)= rac12\|S(t)\|_{\dot H^1}^2= rac12\|
abla S(t)\|_2^2\) (§2).

definition_zh: 第 \(j\) 個紀錄窗為 \(J_j=(	au_j,	au_{j+1})\)，長度 \(L_j=|J_j|\)，並以 \(s=(t-	au_j)/L_j\in[0,1]\) 作正規化時間（§2）。
definition_en: The \(j\)-th record window is \(J_j=(	au_j,	au_{j+1})\) of length \(L_j=|J_j|\), with normalized time \(s=(t-	au_j)/L_j\in[0,1]\) (§2).

definition_zh:
應變渦能放大率定義為 \(a(t)=-2\int_{\mathbb R^3}\det S\,dx\)，並由應變渦能恆等給出 \(E_0'+2
u E_1=a(t)\)（§3）。
definition_en:
Strain-enstrophy amplification is \(a(t)=-2\int_{\mathbb R^3}\det S\,dx\), entering the identity \(E_0'+2
u E_1=a(t)\) (§3).

definition_zh: 中間荷載定義為 \(m(t)=\int\lambda_2^+|S|^2\,dx\)，並由 C4-H 點態矩陣不等式控制 \(a(t)\le m(t)\)（§3）。
definition_en: Middle load is \(m(t)=\int\lambda_2^+|S|^2\,dx\), dominating amplification via the C4-H bound \(a(t)\le m(t)\) (§3).
notes: The pointwise bound \(a\le m\) is inherited from C4-H.

definition_zh:
中間鬆弛定義為 \(q(t)=m(t)-a(t)\ge0\)，從而給出精確點態帳本 \(m=E_0'+2
u E_1+q\)（§4）。
definition_en:
Middle slack is the nonnegative remainder \(q(t)=m(t)-a(t)\ge0\), yielding the exact pointwise ledger \(m=E_0'+2
u E_1+q\) (§4).

definition_zh: 紀錄窗 \(J_j\) 上的中間總荷載（total middle toll）定義為 \(\mathcal M_j=\int_{J_j}m(t)\,dt>0\)（§5）。
definition_en: The total middle toll on the record window \(J_j\) is \(\mathcal M_j=\int_{J_j}m(t)\,dt>0\) (§5).

definition_zh: 正規化中間供給路徑定義為 \(C_j(s)=\mathcal M_j^{-1}\int_{	au_j}^{t_j(s)}m(t)\,dt\)，單調非減且 \(C_j(0)=0\)、\(C_j(1)=1\)（§6、§8）。
definition_en: The normalized middle-supply path is \(C_j(s)=\mathcal M_j^{-1}\int_{	au_j}^{t_j(s)}m(t)\,dt\), nondecreasing with \(C_j(0)=0\) and \(C_j(1)=1\) (§6, §8).

definition_zh:
正規化應變耗散需求路徑定義為 \(D_j(s)=(2
u/\mathcal M_j)\int_{	au_j}^{t_j(s)}E_1(t)\,dt\)，單調非減且值域落在 \([0,1]\)（§6、§8）。
definition_en:
The normalized strain-dissipation demand path is \(D_j(s)=(2
u/\mathcal M_j)\int_{	au_j}^{t_j(s)}E_1(t)\,dt\), nondecreasing and valued in \([0,1]\) (§6, §8).

definition_zh: 正規化中間鬆弛累積路徑定義為 \(Q_j(s)=\mathcal M_j^{-1}\int_{	au_j}^{t_j(s)}q(t)\,dt\)，單調非減且 \(Q_j(0)=0\)（§6、§8）。
definition_en: The normalized cumulative middle-slack path is \(Q_j(s)=\mathcal M_j^{-1}\int_{	au_j}^{t_j(s)}q(t)\,dt\), nondecreasing with \(Q_j(0)=0\) (§6, §8).

definition_zh: 正規化 \(E_0\) 紀錄位移定義為 \(R_j(s)=(E_0(t_j(s))-E_0(	au_j))/\mathcal M_j\)，並滿足 \(-2\le R_j(s)\le1\)（§6、§8）。
definition_en: Normalized \(E_0\) record displacement is \(R_j(s)=(E_0(t_j(s))-E_0(	au_j))/\mathcal M_j\), taking values in \([-2,1]\) (§6, §8).

definition_zh: 定理 7.1（C5-C.1）斷言對所有 \(s\in[0,1]\) 有精確中間累積帳本 \(C_j(s)=R_j(s)+D_j(s)+Q_j(s)\)（§7）。
definition_en: Theorem 7.1 (C5-C.1) asserts the exact middle cumulative ledger \(C_j(s)=R_j(s)+D_j(s)+Q_j(s)\) for all \(s\in[0,1]\) (§7).
notes: Helly compactness of the monotone paths \(C_j,D_j,Q_j\) is recorded in §9; the X-guard G-CUMLEDGER requires preserving this identity.

definition_zh: 中間紀錄分數 \(\alpha_j^{mid}=(E_0(	au_{j+1})-E_0(	au_j))/\mathcal M_j>0\) 滿足端點帳本 \(1=\alpha_j^{mid}+\delta_j^{mid}+Q_j(1)\)（§8）。
definition_en: The middle record fraction \(\alpha_j^{mid}=(E_0(	au_{j+1})-E_0(	au_j))/\mathcal M_j>0\) obeys the endpoint ledger \(1=\alpha_j^{mid}+\delta_j^{mid}+Q_j(1)\) (§8).
notes: Carries over from C5-A; the quantity \(1-\alpha_j^{mid}\) is the inefficiency budget controlling supply deficit (§12–§13).

definition_zh:
耗散需求總質量定義為 \(\delta_j^{mid}=D_j(1)=(2
u/\mathcal M_j)\int_{J_j}E_1\,dt\)，並滿足 \(0\le\delta_j^{mid}\le1\)（§8、§16）。
definition_en:
Total dissipation-demand mass is \(\delta_j^{mid}=D_j(1)=(2
u/\mathcal M_j)\int_{J_j}E_1\,dt\), satisfying \(0\le\delta_j^{mid}\le1\) (§8, §16).

definition_zh: 中間供給速率 \(c_j(s)=C_j'(s)=L_j m(t_j(s))/\mathcal M_j\ge0\) 滿足 \(\int_0^1 c_j\,ds=1\)（§10）。
definition_en: The middle supply rate \(c_j(s)=C_j'(s)=L_j m(t_j(s))/\mathcal M_j\ge0\) is a probability density on \([0,1]\) (§10).

definition_zh:
應變耗散需求速率 \(d_j(s)=D_j'(s)=2
u L_j E_1(t_j(s))/\mathcal M_j\ge0\) 是交叉曲率所作用的非負路徑，且 \(\int_0^1 d_j=\delta_j^{mid}\le1\)（§10、§25）。
definition_en:
The strain-dissipation demand rate \(d_j(s)=D_j'(s)=2
u L_j E_1(t_j(s))/\mathcal M_j\ge0\) is the nonnegative path whose curvature encodes operator sign, with \(\int_0^1 d_j=\delta_j^{mid}\le1\) (§10, §25).
notes: C5-C.5 identifies \(O^+\)/\(O^-\) with the convexity/concavity sources of \(d_j\) (§27–§28).

definition_zh:
沿用 C5-A/B 的算子符號增長 \(h(t)=E_1'(t)=
u(\zeta r_
u-1)\|\Delta S\|_2^2\)，其正負部分積分分別為 \(P_j\) 與 \(N_j\)（§20）。
definition_en:
Operator signed growth, carried from C5-A/B, is \(h(t)=E_1'(t)=
u(\zeta r_
u-1)\|\Delta S\|_2^2\), with positive/negative integrals \(P_j\) and \(N_j\) (§20).
notes: Carries over from C5-A/B; C5-C reinterprets \(\mathrm{sign}(h)\) as the curvature sign of \(d_j\).

definition_zh: 算子 BV 紀錄路徑 \(G_j(s)=(E_1(t_j(s))-E_1(	au_j))/V_j^{op}\) 滿足 \(G_j(0)=0\)、\(G_j(1)= eta_j^{op}>0\) 且 \(\operatorname{Var}_{[0,1]}G_j=1\)（§21）。
definition_en: The operator BV record path \(G_j(s)=(E_1(t_j(s))-E_1(	au_j))/V_j^{op}\) satisfies \(G_j(0)=0\), \(G_j(1)= eta_j^{op}>0\), and \(\operatorname{Var}_{[0,1]}G_j=1\) (§21).
notes: Theorem 22.1 (C5-C.3) compactifies \(G_j\) to some \(G_\ast\in BV([0,1])\) with \(\operatorname{Var} G_\ast\le 1\).

definition_zh:
交叉曲率數定義為 \(\kappa_j^{MO}=2
u L_j V_j^{op}/\mathcal M_j\)，並精確等於 \(\operatorname{Var}_{[0,1]}d_j\)，從而使 \(Dd_j=\kappa_j^{MO}(\mu_j^{op,+}-\mu_j^{op,-})\)（§26–§27）。
definition_en:
The cross-curvature number is \(\kappa_j^{MO}=2
u L_j V_j^{op}/\mathcal M_j\), equal to \(\operatorname{Var}_{[0,1]}d_j\), and satisfies \(Dd_j=\kappa_j^{MO}(\mu_j^{op,+}-\mu_j^{op,-})\) (§26–§27).
notes: The boxed intro form uses \((D_j^0)''\) and \(P_j+N_j\); the body identifies \(d_j=D_j'\) and \(V_j^{op}=P_j+N_j\). Guard G-CROSSCURV.

definition_zh: 算子導數測度由分布意義 \(DG_j=\mu_j^{op,+}-\mu_j^{op,-}\) 給出，且 \(|DG_j|=\mu_j^{op,+}+\mu_j^{op,-}\) 為總質量 1 的測度（§23）。
definition_en: Operator derivative measures satisfy \(DG_j=\mu_j^{op,+}-\mu_j^{op,-}\) distributionally, with \(|DG_j|=\mu_j^{op,+}+\mu_j^{op,-}\) of total mass 1 (§23).
notes: Weak-star limits of \(|DG_j|\) and \(DG_j\) produce \(\Lambda_\ast^{op}\) and \(DG_\ast\) used to define the variation-cancellation defect.

definition_zh: 算子變分相消缺陷定義為 \(\mathfrak D_\ast^{op}=\Lambda_\ast^{op}-|DG_\ast|\ge0\)，記錄在符號 BV 極限中互相抵消的有限尺度 \(O^+/O^-\) 微觀變分（§24）。
definition_en: The operator variation-cancellation defect is \(\mathfrak D_\ast^{op}=\Lambda_\ast^{op}-|DG_\ast|\ge0\), recording finite-scale \(O^+/O^-\) micro-variation cancelled in the signed BV limit (§24).

definition_zh: 即使 \(\kappa_j^{MO}\) 有界，曲率變分缺陷 \(\mathfrak D_\ast^{curv}=\Lambda_\ast^{curv}-|Dd_\ast|\ge0\) 仍可記錄在極限速率 \(d_\ast\) 中被相消的有限尺度曲率開關（§33）。
definition_en: Even for bounded \(\kappa_j^{MO}\), the curvature variation defect \(\mathfrak D_\ast^{curv}=\Lambda_\ast^{curv}-|Dd_\ast|\ge0\) records finite-scale curvature switches cancelled in the limit rate \(d_\ast\) (§33).
notes: Guard G-CURVDEF: BV limits must separate \(|Dd_\ast|\) from total curvature mass; this is the C-T2 micro-oscillation regime of §50.

definition_zh: 當 \(c_j+d_j>0\) 時供給分數為 \(	heta_j(s)=c_j/(c_j+d_j)\in[0,1]\)，否則取 \(	heta_j=1/2\)（§17）。
definition_en: The supply fraction is \(	heta_j(s)=c_j/(c_j+d_j)\in[0,1]\) when \(c_j+d_j>0\), and \(	heta_j=1/2\) otherwise (§17).

label_zh: 供給–需求 Young 測度
definition_zh: 供給–需求 Young 測度 \(\mathscr S_j=(s,	heta_j)_{\#}\Lambda_j^{SD}\) 是 \([0,1]	imes[0,1]\) 上的推前測度，其弱極限滿足封閉相容約束 \((1+\delta_\ast)\int[1-2	heta]_+\,d\mathscr S_\ast\le1-\alpha_\ast\)（§16、§19）。
definition_en: The supply–demand Young measure \(\mathscr S_j=(s,	heta_j)_{\#}\Lambda_j^{SD}\) is a pushforward on \([0,1]	imes[0,1]\) whose weak limit obeys the closed compatibility constraint \((1+\delta_\ast)\int[1-2	heta]_+\,d\mathscr S_\ast\le1-\alpha_\ast\) (§16, §19).
notes: Here \(d\Lambda_j^{SD}=(c_j+d_j)/(1+\delta_j)\,ds\) is the supply–demand common probability on \([0,1]\) (§16).

definition_zh: 帶算子符號標記的供給–需求狀態 \(\mathscr T_j=(s,	heta_j,\sigma_j)_{\#}\Lambda_j^{SD}\) 活在緊集 \([0,1]	imes[0,1]	imes\{-1,0,+1\}\) 上（§37）。
definition_en: The operator-sign-marked supply–demand state \(\mathscr T_j=(s,	heta_j,\sigma_j)_{\#}\Lambda_j^{SD}\) lives on the compact \([0,1]	imes[0,1]	imes\{-1,0,+1\}\) (§37).
notes: The integrand of the supply-deficit constraint is independent of \(\sigma\), so marking does not change the inequality (§38); anti-phase mass \(\mathfrak A_\ast^+\) is the \(\sigma=+1\) slice (§39).

definition_zh: 交叉曲率體制 C-K∞ 指 \(\kappa_j^{MO}	o\infty\)，此時 \(\operatorname{Var}d_j	o\infty\) 而 \(\|d_j\|_{L^1}\le1\)，算子轉移無法被普通 BV 緊緻性吸收而形成曲率壅塞（§30、§34）。
definition_en: The C-K∞ regime is \(\kappa_j^{MO}	o\infty\), forcing \(\operatorname{Var}d_j	o\infty\) while \(\|d_j\|_{L^1}\le1\), so operator transitions escape ordinary BV compactness as curvature congestion (§30, §34).
notes: Sibling regimes are C-K0 (vanishing curvature, demand-rate flattening, §31) and C-KF (finite curvature, BV transition closure, §32); C5-B operator phase measure is the normalized curvature profile of C-K∞ (§34).

definition_zh: C5-C 時間轉移狀態 \(\Theta_\ast^{TC}\) 收集極限累積路徑 \(C_\ast,D_\ast,Q_\ast,R_\ast\)、Young 態 \(\mathscr S_\ast,\mathscr T_\ast\)、算子 BV 路徑 \(G_\ast\)、交叉曲率尺度與各缺陷測度（§59）。
definition_en: The C5-C temporal transition state \(\Theta_\ast^{TC}\) collects the limit cumulative paths \(C_\ast,D_\ast,Q_\ast,R_\ast\), Young states \(\mathscr S_\ast,\mathscr T_\ast\), the operator BV path \(G_\ast\), the cross-curvature scale, and the defect measures (§59).
notes: The load-concentration defects \(\mathfrak c_M,\mathfrak c_+\) carry over from C5-B and appear as the C-T4 alternative in §50.

definition_zh: 定理 13.1（C5-C.2）斷言 \(\int_0^1[d_j-c_j]_+\,ds\le1-\alpha_j^{mid}\)，即正規化供給赤字不得超出中間紀錄無效率預算（§13）。
definition_en: Theorem 13.1 (C5-C.2) asserts \(\int_0^1[d_j-c_j]_+\,ds\le1-\alpha_j^{mid}\), so normalized supply deficit cannot exceed the middle-record inefficiency budget (§13).
notes: Guard G-SUPDEM: middle supply \(c\) and strain demand \(d\) must not be collapsed into a single load.

definition_zh: 結論 48.1（C5-C.7）斷言僅憑 \(E_0/E_1\) 帳本、中間上界強迫與交叉曲率恆等，仍不足以禁止分離的 \(O^+\to M\)（及反向）補償排序（§45–§48）。
definition_en: Conclusion 48.1 (C5-C.7) asserts that the \(E_0/E_1\) ledgers, middle upper forcing, and cross-curvature identity still do not forbid a separated \(O^+\to M\) (or reverse) compensation ordering (§45–§48).
notes: The §45–§47 construction is an abstract scalar ledger, not an N–S orbit (guard G-ORDERNO); it marks the logical boundary of pure temporal-scalar closure (G-TEMPEND).
